shots.content: Inside a game room, a rectangular board-game table stands between a shelving unit and the doorway, with a window along one side. A man in a mustard sweater sits at the shelf-side window seat and asks a question, while a woman in a burgundy hoodie sits at the shelf-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the doorway end, looking lengthwise along the game table toward the shelving unit, with both window-side seats and the shelf-end seat in frame.

shots.content: A woman in a navy blazer enters and takes the doorway-side window seat. A man in a mustard sweater speaks, and she answers.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A man in a mustard sweater replies.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot from directly above the game table, centered on the tabletop, with both window-side seats and the shelf-end seat in frame.
